name: Victoria House
positioning: Boutique beach resort on the east side of Ambergris Caye, at the edge of the Belize Barrier Reef, with thatched casitas, suites and villas facing the Caribbean Sea
best_for: Couples looking for seclusion, including honeymooners eyeing the beachfront Honeymoon Suite
Divers and snorkelers who want the Belize Barrier Reef and an onsite dive shop on the doorstep
Families or groups wanting a beachfront villa with its own private pool

facts.text: Victoria House is a beach resort on the east side of Ambergris Caye, facing Coconut Drive, the road into nearby San Pedro.
A tropical buffer separates the road from the resort's rooms, villas and casitas, which all face the Caribbean Sea.
Victoria House describes itself as a boutique resort for travelers seeking seclusion and intimacy.
The resort has an onsite dive shop and a tour desk.
Excursions include ancient Mayan temples, a zip-line tour over the jungle canopy, rainforest expeditions, fishing trips and diving the Great Blue Hole.
Guests can use the resort's bicycles, kayaks and paddleboards.
The casitas have a thatched roof, a queen bed, a private veranda and a hammock.
The one-bedroom Infinity Suites have a gourmet kitchen and three private verandas, including a secluded upper terrace with ocean views.
The Luxury Villas have traditional thatch roofs, mahogany four-poster canopied king beds and travertine bathrooms.
At La Luna Spa, the Victoria House Signature Treatment combines a Coco Body Polish, a warm al fresco shower and a Signature Relaxation Massage.
Palmilla Restaurant is a full-service waterfront restaurant where fresh, local seafood is a specialty.
Private candlelit dinners can be held on the pier palapa or at a private beach table lit with tiki torches.

highlights.text: Victoria House sits at the edge of the Belize Barrier Reef.
The beachfront villas Casa Playa Blanca and Casa Azul each have their own private pool.
The Rainforest Suite is the resort's beachfront Honeymoon Suite, with a wraparound veranda, a private hammock and views of the Caribbean Sea.
The resort has outdoor infinity-edged pools and a private beach.
The spa offers the Arvigo Maya Abdominal Massage, developed in Belize with a traditional Maya healer.

considerations.text: Staff can help arrange golf cart rentals, taxis and shuttles for getting around.
Room rates do not include government tax and service charge.
WhataHotel notes the island location requires a boat or small aircraft transfer.
